title: Sakana AI publishes JFinBench finance eval
summary: Sakana AI released JFinBench, 321 questions from six 2026 Japanese finance certification exams, including tax calculations, essays, and diagram reading, built with a human-checked agent pipeline. On 12 recent models, open-weight systems that match proprietary models on major benchmarks still trail, mainly from gaps in Japanese legal and accounting knowledge.
